proposal.title: Dead-feed detection
proposal.body: After two weeks of failed polls the fetcher flags a feed as dead (fetcher/dead.go).

proposal.title: Poll scheduling
proposal.body: Polls are spread across each hour by a hash of the feed (fetcher/schedule.go).

sources.file:fetcher/schedule.go#L1-L40@3c1f9a2: // spread assigns each feed a minute of the hour from its hash.

proposal.title: Favicons
proposal.body: fetcher/favicon.go fetches each site's icon weekly and caches it under icons/.

sources.file:fetcher/favicon.go#L1-L40@3c1f9a2: // favicon.go fetches each feed site's icon once a week and caches it under icons/.

proposal.title: Image proxy
proposal.body: The sync server proxies article images through /v1/img so readers do not leak their IP to feed hosts.

sources.note:web/images.md: Images go through /v1/img on the sync server, so the reader's IP never reaches the feed host.

proposal.title: Images via the server
proposal.body: Article images load through the sync server's /v1/img route, hiding the reader's IP from feed hosts.

sources.file:server/src/routes/img.rs#L1-L40@3c1: /// /v1/img proxies article images so feed hosts never see the reader's IP.

proposal.title: Dead feed revival
proposal.body: fetcher/dead.go retries a dead feed once a week and revives it when a poll succeeds.
